meta.title: Workspace archiver
meta.description: Adds “Archive and hide this workspace” to a workspace row's context menu (right-click or the … button) in the sidebar. It archives every unarchived session of that workspace, then removes the workspace registration so the row disappears; the directory and all session logs are kept. If any session cannot be archived (running work or missing permission), the workspace is left in place and the notice reports how many sessions blocked the action. This is a one-way archive: re-adding the directory creates a new empty workspace, and old sessions are not reattached. The shipped Delete workspace action removes the registration without archiving sessions.
